OUR HOLISTIC METHODOLOGY
Our holistic approach to risk management means that we are
concerned not only with the risk itself, but root causes and the
range of consequences. This in turn means that we:
• Address all aspects of risk, be they commercial,
operational, fi nancial, strategic, reputational, and both
internal or external compliance risks
• Learn lessons when things go wrong or play out
unexpectedly
• Strive to be agile and to identify and respond to risks
